name: Rexford Industrial Realty, Inc.
tagline: REXR is a self-administered and self-managed REIT focused on owning, operating, and acquiring industrial properties in Southern California infill markets to generate attractive risk-adjusted returns.
hero_kpi_rationale: Le portefeuille de REXR, mesuré en millions de pieds carrés louables, est le principal indicateur de sa taille et de sa portée sur le marché immobilier industriel de Californie du Sud.
